recovery_steps.title: Assess PostgreSQL container status
recovery_steps.description: Determine if PostgreSQL container is running and accessible
recovery_steps.expected_result: Container status and PostgreSQL availability determined

recovery_steps.title: Stop dependent services
recovery_steps.description: Stop Keycloak and dependent services to prevent data corruption

troubleshooting.services_still_running: Check for external connections and force stop if needed

recovery_steps.title: Create current database backup
recovery_steps.description: Backup current state before recovery attempts
commands: docker exec keycloak-postgres pg_dump -U keycloak keycloak > backups/emergency/$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)/pre_recovery.sql || echo "Backup failed - database may be corrupted"
recovery_steps.expected_result: Current state backed up or corruption confirmed

troubleshooting.backup_fails: Database likely corrupted - proceed with restore from known good backup
troubleshooting.insufficient_disk: Clean up old backups or use alternative storage

recovery_steps.title: Restore from latest backup
recovery_steps.description: Restore PostgreSQL from most recent known-good backup
commands: docker exec keycloak-postgres dropdb -U keycloak keycloak --if-exists
docker exec keycloak-postgres createdb -U keycloak keycloak
docker exec -i keycloak-postgres psql -U keycloak -d keycloak < "$LATEST_BACKUP"

troubleshooting.restore_fails: Try older backup or initiate manual database reconstruction
troubleshooting.permission_errors: Verify Docker container permissions and volume mounts

troubleshooting.postgres_wont_start: Check database corruption, disk space, and configuration
troubleshooting.keycloak_startup_fails: Check logs for database connection errors

health_checks.command: docker exec keycloak-postgres psql -U keycloak -d keycloak -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_entity"

escalation.rto_breach_15min: Contact Database Administrator and Infrastructure Team
escalation.multiple_restore_failures: Engage vendor support and consider disaster recovery site
escalation.data_corruption_detected: Contact Security team and preserve forensic evidence

steps: Plan maintenance window for proper fix

initial_alert.subject: CRITICAL: Authentication services unavailable
initial_alert.body: Keycloak authentication system is currently unavailable. Users cannot log in. Recovery in progress. ETA: 15 minutes.

recovery_complete.subject: RESOLVED: Authentication services restored
recovery_complete.body: Keycloak authentication system has been restored. All services operational. Recovery time: {duration} minutes.
